skills.name: 2build_agent-first-docs
skills.description: Write a product's docs, quick start or marketing page around one copyable coding-agent prompt, and serve docs as agent-readable Markdown (llms.txt, .md URLs). Use for onboarding docs, quick starts, product pages, heroes and CTAs.

skills.name: 2build_architect
skills.description: Map a system's current architecture and design its next generation with diagrams: verified as-is design, headroom, safety gaps, and a staged scaling roadmap (edge, database, cache, jobs, replicas, services) where each stage waits for a measured trigger.

skills.name: 2build_autopilot
skills.description: Deliver one ticket end-to-end from a requirement or accepted plan to a verified, releasable change left uncommitted in its checkout. Own implementation, review fixes, QA, and evidence across resumes; the default for any size of change, including a day-long one. Use team only for phased releases, independent phase verification or parallel work on disjoint parts.

skills.name: 2build_browse
skills.description: Use the browser for focused web-app checks: open a URL, inspect state, click through a flow, capture screenshots, read console errors, or verify a frontend fix. Prefer this over a full QA workflow.

skills.name: 2build_create-pr
skills.description: Prepare and create a pull request from the current branch. Use when a human requests a PR; 2build workflows never open one.

skills.name: 2build_design-ui
skills.description: Design and iterate a reviewable UI using the project's design authority and existing screens. Use for UI design requests or a workflow's design/prototype handoff; a direct build request can use the working UI as its prototype.

skills.name: 2build_harness-audit
skills.description: Audit AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and linked project instructions against repository code, scripts, CI and agent configuration. Use to find stale commands, broken references, conflicting rules or missing verification paths; setup-project owns initial 2build configuration.

skills.name: 2build_humanizer-vi
skills.description: Rewrite AI-sounding or machine-translated Vietnamese so it reads like a Vietnamese writer without changing what it says. Use when editing, reviewing or translating Vietnamese prose, scripts or docs for AI tells such as "không chỉ... mà còn", staged openers ("Hãy cùng khám phá"), calques of English idioms, "việc/sự/một cách" nominalization, "được... bởi" passives, inflated words (đột phá, nâng tầm, hành trình), sales language, dashes, bold labels or filler.

skills.name: 2build_image-gen
skills.description: Generate raster images locally with Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (Metal, no account, no network at generation time) and cut subjects out of their background with RMBG-1.4. Use for draft plates, backgrounds, covers, stickers and reference-guided edits; not pixel-exact edits, UI mock-ups or likenesses of real people.

skills.name: 2build_implement
skills.description: Implement a scoped code change from the user's request, an accepted plan.md, or ticket context. Use for feature work, bug fixes, endpoints, UI changes, integrations, and contained refactors.

skills.name: 2build_investigate
skills.description: Debug a failure before fixing it. Use when the user asks why something is broken, wants root cause analysis, or reports an error, regression, flaky test, crash, or unexpected behavior.

skills.name: 2build_marketing-video
skills.description: Plan and produce marketing videos for your own product on TikTok, YouTube (Shorts and long-form), Instagram and Facebook Reels, X and LinkedIn, for any product and any kind of video, from research to a script strangers can retell, art, voice, edit and per-platform files; you post them.

skills.name: 2build_perf-audit
skills.description: Audit one feature's or the whole system's performance for an owner who is not an engineer: what users feel, proven causes from production signals, fixes ranked easiest and safest first. Use when something feels slow, before buying capacity, or to verify a fix.

skills.name: 2build_plan-draft
skills.description: Draft a technical plan before implementation. Use when the user asks for a plan, architecture, ticket breakdown, or wants to turn a requirement into plan.md without coding yet.

skills.name: 2build_qa
skills.description: Systematically test a web application, fix issues caused by the current change, and re-verify. Use for full QA loops, critical user flows, release checks, or test-and-fix requests.

skills.name: 2build_recon
skills.description: Evaluate an external repository, library, or tool against the current project. Use for adoption decisions, architecture comparisons, or requests to explore and borrow from another project.

skills.name: 2build_release
skills.description: Release a repository or selected services to production, from version and changelog through main sync, GitHub release, package distribution, deployment and hypercare. Supports --local when CI quota is exhausted; use --dry-run for a read-only release plan.

skills.name: 2build_review-pr
skills.description: Review code before it lands — the current branch, working diff, or a GitHub pull request. Use when asked to review a PR/diff/change, run a code review, do a pre-merge or pre-commit check, hunt for bugs, or gate a change before landing. Surfaces correctness bugs, removed behavior, cross-file breakage, security, performance, and cleanup, then verifies each candidate before reporting. Effort levels low|medium|high|xhigh|max (default medium; only an explicit human request runs above medium); --fix applies findings to the working tree, --comment posts inline PR comments. Claude Code /code-review pipeline with babysit semantic-decision integration.

skills.name: 2build_semantic-decision
skills.description: Make an explicit, structured judgment from evidence and bounded choices. Use for task sizing, skill routing, orchestration need, test impact, review findings, recovery, decision tiers, or whether human/deeper review is warranted. Defaults to the current LLM; configured Cloudflare Clef/Clef-flash can replace the provider.

skills.name: 2build_setup-project
skills.description: Initialize or update a repo's 2build configuration, QA target, architecture and release documents, and project pointers. Use for onboarding or requested configuration changes; use harness-audit to inspect existing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and related harness files.

skills.name: 2build_telemetry-review
skills.description: Review 2build's own telemetry, not product analytics. Use to turn ~/.babysit/analytics (skill-usage.jsonl, decisions.jsonl) into a short ticket-ready report — which skills fire and fail, whether plan-draft habitually over-sizes, where runs go BLOCKED.

skills.name: 2build_test
skills.description: Create meaningful regression coverage, audit weak or redundant tests, and optimize test lanes using measured cost and change impact. Use for test creation, suite audits, failing-test investigation, or CI test optimization; browser journey QA stays with qa/browse.

skills.name: 2build_token-audit
skills.description: Audit where agent sessions spend tokens and what every session loads before work starts (skill listing, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, memory), then rank savings that keep quality. Use when runs feel expensive, before tuning skills, models, effort or compaction, or to check background context bloat.

skills.name: 2build_triage
skills.description: Tier-1 triage for a stalled or BLOCKED autonomous run. Use when a worker returned BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT or a ticket's checkpoint stopped advancing — classify recoverable vs needs-human, post a structured handoff, optionally resume from the checkpoint.

skills.name: 2build_ui-audit
skills.description: Audit a running app's UI/UX by walking real user or founder journeys end to end (PASS/FRICTION/BLOCKED), checking every screen against backend ground truth, dead ends, discoverability, information density (too much text; icons and layout over prose) and non-happy paths; scored with PURE step ratings, Nielsen severities and measured thresholds. Also builds the flow inventory and re-audits after a fix. Use before planning UI improvements, when users report getting stuck, or to audit a live app safely.
